reference_scope: 5-on-5 with both goalies present. Special teams, extra-attacker and empty-net evidence are distinct strata; physical test results require demonstrated transfer before informing this game-performance headline.

attributes.name: Skating
attributes.construct: Repeatable ability to generate, change and redirect on-ice movement while preserving task-relevant balance and control on a standardized movement battery.
attributes.current_coverage: One saved historical EDGE profile supplies maximum/burst context. Population acceleration, agility and transition evidence are absent.

components.name: Speed
components.measure: Context-adjusted robust upper-quantile speed and repeated-burst distribution; keep a single maximum descriptive.

components.name: Acceleration
components.measure: Time over first 6 m in a registered stationary-start test, or separately calibrated game speed-band time. Do not pool unbridged protocols.

components.name: Agility
components.measure: Geometry-adjusted turn/braking completion and exit-speed loss, jointly retaining path compliance.

components.name: Transitions
components.measure: Transition latency and speed retained conditional on correct exit orientation.

attributes.name: Handling
attributes.construct: Repeatable execution of receiving, controlling, protecting and escaping with the puck while preserving an intentional next action under specified pressure.
attributes.current_coverage: Annual losses/takeaways lack touches, playable-arrival and pressure-challenge denominators. No direct complete Handling estimate.

components.name: Reception
components.measure: Controlled receptions per resolved playable arrivals; retain unplayable/ambiguous arrivals separately.

components.name: Control
components.measure: Controlled completions and puck-separation errors per resolved control task.

components.name: Protection
components.measure: Control-preserving outcomes per protection challenge, stratified wall/open ice/contact.

components.name: Pressure execution
components.measure: Controlled escapes per resolved evasion task; code choice quality separately.

attributes.name: Passing
attributes.construct: Repeatable delivery of a selected puck exchange to a usable target with required range, execution synchronization and supported disguise.
attributes.current_coverage: Assists/shot links lack complete pass attempts, arrival difficulty and option sets. No direct complete Passing estimate.

components.name: Delivery
components.measure: Playable deliveries per resolved attempts; link actual controlled completion separately.

components.name: Range
components.measure: Standardized target success across short/medium/long, side, bank and loft strata; register actual distance boundaries with rink geometry before fit.

components.name: Timing
components.measure: Window-aligned deliveries and arrival timing margin per synchronization task; separate decision latency.

components.name: Deception
components.measure: Conditional usable-delivery contrast under matched contexts; record response and execution separately, without sole causal credit from one play.

attributes.name: Shooting
attributes.construct: Repeatable execution of a selected shot or attacking redirection: functional placement, timely release, usable velocity and conditional finishing.
attributes.current_coverage: Existing finishing experiment covers one facet with wide/vintage/position limits. One old speed maximum cannot supply accuracy, release or repeated velocity.

components.name: Finishing
components.measure: Conditional conversion effect with shrinkage; baseline cannot circularly embed the same shooter-skill parameter. Aggregate Gamma-Poisson is a restricted approximation.

components.name: Accuracy
components.measure: Placement error and target-hit probability conditioned on chosen target/interference; distinguish intentional wide exchanges and tips.

components.name: Release
components.measure: Quality-preserving release latency and window-completion probability, separate from decision latency.

components.name: Velocity
components.measure: Repeated shot-type-adjusted speed distribution; retain a maximum only as descriptive context.

attributes.name: Reading
attributes.construct: Observable effectiveness of information use, anticipation and decision timing among feasible hockey options. This assesses perception-action behavior, not hidden thoughts or general intelligence.
attributes.current_coverage: Annual summaries lack cue visibility, feasible alternatives and decision timestamps. Interviews/scan descriptions are contextual evidence, not direct grades.

components.name: Recognition
components.measure: Pre-outcome option-quality judgments and conditional decision regret; scans remain supporting behavior only.

components.name: Anticipation
components.measure: Cue-conditioned preparation quality and correct/false commitment tradeoff; separate timing from raw movement speed.

components.name: Decision timing
components.measure: Context-adjusted commitment-window alignment with early-action costs; raw reaction milliseconds are insufficient.

attributes.name: Defending
attributes.construct: Repeatable legal containment, coverage, denial and recovery execution against named threats, conditioned on support, geometry and any documented assignment.
attributes.current_coverage: Hits, takeaways, blocks and on-ice threat lack complete individual threat/duty denominators. No complete individual Defending estimate.

components.name: Gap control
components.measure: Matched containment/bypass probability and gap evolution; smallest distance is not automatically best.

components.name: Coverage
components.measure: Contested coverage outcomes per resolved tested threat/duty interval; count untested occupancy separately.

components.name: Denial
components.measure: Denial probability per attributable intervention, adjusted for difficulty and registered penalty costs.

components.name: Recovery execution
components.measure: Restoration probability and time margin per resolved recovery task; mere touches are not control.

attributes.name: Tracking
attributes.construct: Observable acquisition and continuous updating of puck information through release, flight and visual interruption; internal gaze and awareness remain unknown without valid measurement.
attributes.current_coverage: Annual save/GSAx summaries lack acquisition, visibility and gaze evidence. No complete Tracking grade.

components.name: Acquisition
components.measure: Acquisition latency and cue-conditioned response quality.

components.name: Continuity
components.measure: Trajectory-update error and loss rate per observable segment.

components.name: Reacquisition
components.measure: Reacquisition latency and successful response-window alignment.

attributes.name: Positioning
attributes.construct: Maintain task-appropriate angle, alignment, depth and post relation given the puck, possible pass threats, available movement and team support.
attributes.current_coverage: Summary stats do not provide goalie/puck/net geometry or threat envelopes. No complete Positioning grade.

components.name: Alignment
components.measure: Angle/alignment error relative to a preregistered threat-conditioned target envelope.

components.name: Depth
components.measure: Depth-envelope compliance and subsequent task margin.

components.name: Post integration
components.measure: Post-relation task success with seal and exit costs.

attributes.name: Movement
attributes.construct: Execute controlled lateral, vertical and orientation transitions while preserving task-appropriate balance and response readiness.
attributes.current_coverage: Public aggregate records lack task starts, paths and readiness endpoints. No complete Movement grade.

components.name: Lateral execution
components.measure: Travel time and endpoint error conditional on distance/initial stance.

components.name: Set readiness
components.measure: Time-to-ready and available response envelope.

components.name: Orientation changes
components.measure: Transition time, end-state control and task completion.

attributes.name: Rebounds
attributes.construct: Control the first-contact disposition of a save attempt through absorption, directed deflection and usable subsequent containment, conditional on incoming difficulty and feasible technique.
attributes.current_coverage: Aggregate rebound counts and GSAx do not resolve feasibility, direction or support. No complete Rebounds grade.

components.name: Absorption
components.measure: Secure/deaden probability per eligible contact.

components.name: Steering
components.measure: Threat-conditioned outgoing direction/energy error.

components.name: Containment
components.measure: Containment probability and outgoing access advantage.

attributes.name: Recovery
attributes.construct: Restore information, useful position and response readiness after a save, collision or scramble, given the actual feasible next threat.
attributes.current_coverage: Season summaries cannot reconstruct post-save starting states and deadlines. No complete Recovery grade.

components.name: Reorientation
components.measure: Reorientation time and correct/false orientation tradeoff.

components.name: Repositioning
components.measure: Restoration success and time margin conditional on initial disadvantage.

components.name: Follow-up readiness
components.measure: Readiness and response-option preservation per recovery sequence.

attributes.name: Puck Play
attributes.construct: Execute retrieval, control and delivery while making supported possession choices and coordinating exchanges under goalie-specific rules and risk.
attributes.current_coverage: Public season summaries do not contain complete retrieval, options and exchange denominators. No complete Puck Play grade.

components.name: Retrieval and control
components.measure: Task completion and control margin under pressure.

components.name: Delivery
components.measure: Target-conditioned delivery success with pressure/risk.

components.name: Possession decisions
components.measure: Outcome-blinded decision quality and coordinated-exchange success.
